picks.headline: Musixmatch CEO: lyrics are becoming 'the LLM of the music industry'
picks.excerpt: Musixmatch CEO Max Ciociola says lyrics are becoming 'the LLM of the music industry'; the company struck a deal with Suno for a copyright-detection tool called Sentinel.
picks.rationale: The freshest strategic insight in the pool: lyrics data is being positioned as AI infrastructure. It is a CEO interview, not a repeat of the 8/7 Sentinel-deal card.

picks.headline: VirtualDJ 2026 adds AI 'Vibescripting' and custom ShoutOut voiceovers
picks.excerpt: VirtualDJ 2026 gets its third and final update: ShoutOut custom voiceovers, AI scripting ('Vibescripting'), and improved controller and streaming support.
picks.rationale: A concrete tool release that DJs can use tomorrow. It adds natural-language AI scripting to a mainstream DJ app and has not been published before.

picks.headline: ClassicalBot uses AI to map classical concerts worldwide
picks.excerpt: ClassicalBot uses AI to map classical-music concerts, starting in the developer's home country before expanding worldwide.
picks.rationale: A fresh AI discovery product in the under-covered classical niche. It adds a third outlet and a new use case (live-event discovery).

picks.headline: Glazmo's new tools mangle Ableton tempos and build drum kits from AI-surfed YouTube 'slop'
picks.excerpt: Oliver Torr (Glazmo Network) mangles Ableton Live tempos with MIRA and assembles drum kits out of AI-surfed YouTube 'slop' in new experimental tools.
picks.rationale: A creative-producer angle: experimental tools that turn AI-found audio into sampling material. It is a fourth outlet and new to the brief.

picks.headline: Man who made $8m from AI songs and bot streams asks for no prison time
picks.excerpt: Michael Smith, who made $8m streaming AI-generated songs with bots, asks for no prison time, arguing the losses were 'tiny, immeasurable' per artist.
picks.rationale: This is the landmark AI-music streaming-fraud case reaching sentencing. It has never been published (it was only not_selected on 9/28). This is the second MBW card, the per-outlet maximum.
